Position Overview The Software Quality Assurance Engineer is responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of Ceragon software and hardware products. This role collaborates closely with development, product, and engineering teams to validate requirements, identify defects, and verify that software releases meet defined specifications and quality standards. Key Responsibilities Review product requirements, design specifications, and technical documentation to understand scope, functionality, and expected behavior Develop, maintain, and execute test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on specifications and stakeholder input Design, develop, and execute automated test scripts using tools like Selenium, Postman, Jenkins Identify functional, reliability, accuracy, performance, and standards-based testing parameters Conduct manual and exploratory testing on software applications, web interfaces, and related technical products Validate new features, enhancements, and bug fixes prior to release Perform regression testing to ensure existing functionality is not negatively affected by changes Identify, reproduce, document, and track defects, including detailed steps to reproduce and supporting evidence Verify defect fixes and ensure resolutions meet acceptance criteria. Administrator Job Description About Us: We are a dynamic and innovative global organization seeking a highly skilled DevOps and Linux Administrator to join our IT team. You will play a key role in managing and optimizing enterprise Linux systems across our global operations while supporting modern infrastructure, development workflows, and automation. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment and is eager to expand their skillset into the realms of DevOps , SecOps , and cloud-native technologies . What You’ll Do: Administer and maintain RHEL , Ubuntu , and Oracle Linux systems across enterprise environments. Configure, deploy, and upgrade Linux workstations and servers , ensuring optimal performance, reliability, and security. Implement and enforce organizational policies related to security and compliance, particularly within the context of Linux systems. Provide Linux support for Kubernetes , Docker , and other containerized environments, enabling seamless cloud-native development and CI/CD pipelines. Automate administrative processes using scripting and internal tools, contributing to greater operational efficiency. Implement and manage DevOps practices, including infrastructure-as-code (IAC) and continuous integration/deployment. Work with configuration management tools such as Puppet , Ansible , and others to streamline server provisioning, software deployment, and system configurations. Oversee the integration of Linux systems with enterprise-level Networking solutions, including Active Directory and identity management frameworks. Manage the security of systems through advanced configuration, applying best practices from CIS Benchmarks , and actively ensuring systems comply with industry standards. Collaborate with the SecOps team to implement security policies, hardening techniques, and continuous security monitoring. Troubleshoot, resolve, and perform root cause analysis on system-related issues while ensuring minimal downtime and optimal system performance. Job Requirements Proven experience in Linux administration with deep hands-on knowledge of RHEL , Ubuntu , and Oracle Linux . RHCSA certification (Red Hat Certified System Administrator). Strong scripting skills for automation (e.g., Bash, Python, or other scripting languages). Experience with configuration management tools such as Puppet , Ansible , or similar. Experience integrating Linux systems with networking and identity management solutions (e.g., Active Directory , LDAP). Solid knowledge of system security practices, with experience in hardening Linux systems based on CIS Benchmarks and other security frameworks. Hands-on experience with virtualization technologies and working with VM solutions in large-scale environments. Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker , Kubernetes ). Nice to Have: Expertise in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and integrating Linux-based systems into cloud infrastructures. Experience with security compliance , risk management, and implementing automation for SecOps . Experience with network automation and related tools. Familiarity with cloud-native tools, including container orchestration platforms and services. Knowledge of advanced networking protocols , including VLANs, VPNs, firewalls, and DNS. Why Join Us? Work in a modern IT environment with cutting-edge technologies and practices.

Description About Ceragon Ceragon is the global innovator and leading solutions provider of end-to-end wireless connectivity, specializing in transport, access, and AI-powered managed and professional Position Summary The Shipping Coordinator is responsible for managing the end-to-end shipping process for domestic and international shipments across air, sea, and land transportation. The role ensures timely and cost-effective movement of goods while maintaining compliance with customs regulations, company policies, and customer requirements. Working closely with internal stakeholders, freight forwarders, customs agents, and global logistics partners, the Shipping Coordinator plays a key role in ensuring shipment visibility, accurate documentation, invoice validation, and resolution of logistics-related issues. Key Responsibilities : Coordinate end-to-end shipment execution for inbound and outbound shipments across air, sea, and road transportation. Manage local and international transportation activities to ensure timely pickup, transit, customs clearance, and final delivery. Track shipments from dispatch through final delivery, providing regular status updates and maintaining shipment visibility in company systems. Ensure Proof of Delivery (POD) documentation is collected, verified, and uploaded into the Enterprise Planning (EP) system. Coordinate closely with global and local freight forwarders to manage shipment schedules, transportation planning, and issue resolution. Support customs clearance activities for inbound shipments by coordinating with freight forwarders and ensuring required documentation is complete and accurate. Monitor shipment exceptions, delays, and transportation risks, taking proactive actions to minimize business impact. Manage logistics quality issues including NCR (NonConformance Reports) and CDA (Corrective & Preventive Action) activities, working with customers, freight forwarders, and headquarters to resolve issues. Review, validate, and approve freight forwarder invoices to ensure billing accuracy and compliance with agreed commercial terms. Prepare and publish daily and weekly logistics reports, including shipment pickups, ETA updates, priority shipments, delivery performance, and operational metrics. Maintain accurate logistics records and ensure compliance with company procedures, transportation regulations, and audit requirements. Identify opportunities to improve logistics efficiency, shipment visibility, and transportation performance. Job Requirements Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related discipline. 3–6 years of experience in logistics, shipping coordination, freight management, or supply chain operations. Experience working with international freight forwarders and customs processes is preferred. Exposure to ERP systems and logistics management platforms is an advantage. Deliver Maintenance and Service: Perform preventive maintenance and emergency service activities, proactively addressing issues to maximize system uptime and operational continuity. Ensure Safe Execution: Maintain compliance with safety standards and operational protocols, identify potential hazards, and enforce safe working practices for employees and contractors on-site. Assess Sites and Execute Technical Plans: Review site layouts, engineering drawings, and technical documentation using AutoCAD or similar tools. Identify and escalate discrepancies between planned and actual site conditions. Own the On-Site Customer Experience: Serve as the primary technical point of contact during field activities, communicating clearly, managing expectations, and delivering a professional customer experience. Collaborate and Document: Maintain accurate installation and service documentation, escalate complex technical issues to Engineering, R&D, and Operations, and provide field insights that support continuous improvement. Time and Expense Management: You are responsible for managing your time and expenses on a regular basis and in accordance with company guidelines. Responsibilities may include: Extended periods of standing, walking, and working on active job sites. Working in and around vehicle service areas, dealerships, manufacturing facilities, warehouses, and outdoor environments. Performing physical tasks such as lifting, carrying, pushing, or pulling equipment up to 50 lbs. Frequent bending, reaching, climbing, and manual handling of tools or components. Working in varying environmental conditions, including heat, cold, noise, and dust. Use of personal protective equipment (PPE) such as safety shoes, helmets, gloves, and eye protection, as required, The role requires a high level of mobility, physical stamina, and the ability to safely perform hands-on technical work in diverse operational environments. https://brightdata.com/careers/secops-an.description: Careers | Open Job Positions | Bright Data Accessibility Menu skip to content Information Security SecOps Analyst IL, Netanya (Hybrid) Description We are looking for a highly analytical, decisive SecOps Analyst to join our SecOps Team. Our SOC runs on an agentic AI platform that autonomously investigates and correlates security alerts across our infrastructure, cloud, and product environments. Your role is to be the critical human judgment layer: validating AI-driven investigations and owning confirmed incidents end-to-end. If you take full ownership of a problem until it's truly closed, think critically rather than trusting a tool blindly, and want to operate at the frontier of AI-driven security operations, this role is for you. Responsibilities AI Investigation Validation: Review and validate findings from our agentic AI SOC platform. Catch false positives/negatives and surface edge cases internally to improve agent accuracy. End-to-End Incident Ownership: Own confirmed incidents from escalation through containment, remediation, and reporting, driving cases to closure, not just triage. Application & Product Log Monitoring: Investigate anomalies across our application and product logs to detect abuse, tenant/account misuse, and threats unique to our platform. Human-in-the-Loop Decision Authority: Authorize containment actions (isolating a host, suspending an identity, revoking a session) on critical alerts with confidence and speed. Proactive Threat Hunting: Hunt for threats outside the current scope, including business-logic abuse, insider threats, and anomalies unique to our product. Phishing & User Defense: Own confirmed phishing cases end-to-end, from detection through user communication and takedown. Documentation: Maintain clear investigation runbooks and case documentation so knowledge is shared, not siloed. On-Call Rotation: Serve as the decision-maker for high-severity, AI-escalated incidents during off-hours — reserved for high-confidence critical escalations, not noise. Requirements 2+ years of hands-on experience in a SOC, Incident Response, or Threat Intelligence role. Strong experience querying and analyzing logs in Splunk (must). Deep understanding of common attack vectors, MITRE ATT&CK, and enterprise security tools (EDR, IdP, SASE/Firewalls). Demonstrated critical thinking: comfortable questioning AI/automated conclusions rather than accepting them at face value. Strong incident command instincts: fast, confident decisions under pressure with incomplete information. Excellent written and verbal English communication for documentation and cross-functional incident communication. Advantage Experience querying application/observability logs in Logz.io or ELK stack. Experience with AI-driven or agentic security tools. Experience in a SOAR-driven environment. Familiarity with investigating cloud-native threats. Relevant certifications (e.g., GCIA, GCIH, CySA+). Back to careers page Apply for this position

https://sentrycs.com/careers/co/tlv-isra.description: Job opportunity: FPGA Engineer Job opportunity: FPGA Engineer Skip to content Home > Careers Array ← All Jobs FPGA Engineer TLV, israel About The Position Sentrycs’ mission is to enable a more drone-empowered future! How? With our integrated counter-drone solution, we support law enforcement agencies, prisons, critical infrastructures, airports, mass events, convoys, militarizes, and more, by providing them with 24/7 drone protection. With our fully autonomous, easily portable, and UTM-ready technology, detecting and mitigating unauthorized drones has never been simpler. We work to keep society protected from unauthorized eyes in the skies so you can remain operational and ensure business continuity on the ground. Let’s build a drone-empowered future together! As a Senior FPGA & System Architecture Engineer , you will drive the end-to-end hardware architecture and implementation of next-generation wireless communications systems. You will lead the design and integration of high-throughput physical layer pipelines across AMD Xilinx RFSoC platforms, high-speed PCIe interfaces, and host GPU acceleration environments—bridging algorithmic signal processing with production-grade SoC hardware infrastructure. In this role, you will: Architect & Design: Own the full-chip system architecture on AMD Xilinx RFSoC platforms. DSP RTL Implementation: Partner directly with Algorithm Engineers to translate floating-point MATLAB/C++ models into fixed-point, resource-optimized, and bit-exact SystemVerilog RTL. Host & GPU Acceleration Interfacing: Architect and implement high-bandwidth PCIe subsystems connecting the RFSoC to host CPU and GPU accelerators, ensuring deterministic data streaming, low-latency DMA transfers, and reliable link initialization during system boot. Verification & Hardware Bring-Up: Lead bit-accurate simulation, hardware emulation, and lab bring-up using Vivado, logic analyzers, and RF test equipment to profile throughput, validate timing closure, and eliminate real-time system bottlenecks. Requirements The ideal FPGA engineer who we are looking for should have SoC & FPGA Mastery: Proven, hands-on experience architecting and delivering production designs on AMD Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+ RFSoC or MPSoC platforms. HDL & RTL Implementation: Expert-level proficiency in synthesizable SystemVerilog or Verilog , with a strong focus on high-speed pipelining, timing closure in congested designs. Host Interfacing & Data Movement: Demonstrated experience implementing high-bandwidth PCIe subsystems (Gen3/Gen4) and high-throughput DMA engines (e.g., XDMA/QDMA), including link training/enumeration bring-up, boot sequencing, and backpressure management. Nice to Have RF-DC Subsystem Integration: Hands-on experience configuring and integrating AMD Xilinx RF-Data Converters (multi-gigasample ADCs/DACs) and their associated digital down/up-conversion chains. DSP Hardware Design: Strong foundation in implementing fixed-point wireless communications algorithms in FPGA fabric (e.g., polyphase filter banks, multi-rate DDC/DUC, FFT/IFFT, channel estimation, correlation) with efficient DSP slice mapping and dynamic range management. Driver & Software Alignment: Familiarity with Linux kernel drivers, user-space drivers (VFIO/UIO, DPDK), or embedded software running on the ARM Processing System to coordinate hardware-software control planes. https://jobs.lever.co/cloudinary/5cd7d5b.description: Cloudinary - Staff Backend Engineer- Agent Experience (AX) Staff Backend Engineer- Agent Experience (AX) Israel CTO / Full-time / Hybrid apply for this job Cloudinary is the media experience platform trusted by millions of developers and thousands of companies — from fast-growing startups to the world's largest brands — to power the images and video behind their digital experiences. Something fundamental is changing about who uses that platform. Increasingly, the "developer" calling our APIs isn't a person — it's an agent: an LLM, a coding assistant, an autonomous pipeline acting on a human's behalf. Our Agent Experience (AX) R&D team exists to make Cloudinary the default media layer those agents run on. Our guiding principle is simple: make agentic workflows work flawlessly with no friction. We're a small, fast, high-ownership team, and we're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to make Cloudinary work for agents — both by building new agent-facing infrastructure and by reshaping our existing platform for a world where the caller is a machine. Some of this is greenfield. Much of it is taking APIs, auth, and SDKs and making them ergonomic, legible, and reliable for agents. It’s a problem the whole industry is still figuring out. You’ll help define what great API design looks like when the caller is not a human developer, but an agent acting on their behalf. What you'll do Build the surfaces agents call directly: API-first account provisioning, machine-to-machine authentication, scoped credentials, and agent-level identity and attribution. Own our MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and an agent-first CLI — let coding agents and LLMs discover and invoke Cloudinary reliably, engineered for agentic callers: token-efficient tool schemas, machine-parseable output, and loud, actionable failures instead of silent ones. Harden the agent media path — make upload and core media operations reliable for non-human callers, eliminating the ambiguity and silent-failure modes that cause agents to drop off mid-task. Make agent behavior measurable — partner on the instrumentation, signals, and attribution that tell us whether agents are succeeding. Work across a polyglot backend — Node.js/TypeScript for the agent tooling layer, with Ruby/Rails and Go in the core platform. Ship, measure, iterate — prototype quickly, dogfood the experience, and represent the agent's perspective in every design decision. Work closely with Product, Ecosystem, and Discoverability across the AX team. About you 10+ years building and operating production APIs, SDKs and Backend systems and at scale. Strong in Node.js/TypeScript, and comfortable working in (or quickly ramping on) Ruby/Rails and/or Go. Deep API and protocol design fundamentals — authentication (OAuth, API keys, scoped permissions), versioning, idempotency, rate limiting, clean contracts. Genuine curiosity about agents and LLMs and how they're reshaping how software gets built and run. Solid distributed-systems and cloud instincts (AWS or equivalent). A bias for ownership in ambiguity — you scope the problem, not just the solution, and you ship. Strong written communication — it matters more than usual when your consumers are machines and your teammates are distributed. Advantages Hands-on experience with MCP, LLM tool/function-calling, or building AI-/agent-native products. Experience building SDKs, CLIs, or developer tools that other engineers depend on. Background in media, imaging, or video processing/delivery. Open-source contributions in the agent or developer-tooling ecosystem. Cloudinary is an equal opportunity employer. https://www.papayaglobal.com/positions/s.description: Software Architect | Papaya Global Back Software Architect Poland - Kraków Full-time Engineering Description Papaya Global is a rapidly growing, award-winning B2B tech unicorn with an ambitious mission to revolutionize the payroll & payments industry. With over $400M raised from multiple tier-one investors, our innovative technology provides a comprehensive solution for managing global workforces, encompassing everything from hiring and onboarding to managing and paying employees in over 160 countries. About the Role We're looking for a Software Architect to join Papaya's central Architects Team — a small group of senior architects that partners with every R&D department in the company. In this role you won't own a single product silo; instead, you'll move across domains (payments, payroll, workforce management, platform, data, security) to help teams shape sound, scalable, secure systems and to keep Papaya's overall technical direction coherent. This is a hands-on architecture role at the intersection of engineering, product, security, and DevOps. You'll be expected to dive deep into unfamiliar domains quickly, influence without direct authority, and bring the highest bar of technical thinking — including modern AI-assisted engineering practices — to everything you touch. If you're energized by hard problems at global scale, by working across many teams rather than one, and by shaping how a modern engineering organization actually builds software in the age of AI, this role is for you. What You'll Do Lead architectural design across multiple Papaya domains and infrastructure systems, ensuring solutions meet business, scalability, performance, and compliance needs. Act as a trusted architectural partner to R&D, Product, Security, and DevOps teams — translating business and product requirements into clear technical direction. Define and maintain high-level architecture across domains, with a focus on seamless integration, maintainability, and long-term evolvability. Build hands-on Proofs of Concept (POCs) to de-risk architectural decisions, validate new technologies, and demonstrate viable paths forward before broad investment. Lead technical Due Diligence on third-party vendors, platforms, and integrations — evaluating architecture fit, scalability, security posture, compliance, operational maturity, and long-term cost. Drive secure-by-design practices, embedding security, privacy, and regulatory considerations into every stage of system design. Evaluate and introduce emerging technologies, frameworks, and patterns — including AI/LLM-based capabilities — where they create real leverage for the business. Champion the adoption of AI-powered engineering tools and agentic workflows across R&D, helping teams use them effectively, safely, and consistently. Define and steward Papaya's architectural guidelines, standards, and best practices, and help ensure they are actually applied in day-to-day delivery. Provide technical mentorship and architectural guidance to development teams across the company. Review designs, RFCs, and critical implementations to maintain architectural consistency and system quality across projects. Requirements Experience & background 8+ years of proven experience as a System / Software Architect designing robust, scalable systems. 12+ years of hands-on software development experience, with strong proficiency in Java (preferred) or an equivalent backend language. Proven experience building enterprise SaaS platforms, self-service products, and highly scaled production systems. Experience in financial technology (FinTech) or other regulated industries is a strong advantage. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field. Technical depth Deep expertise in cloud-native architecture; strong advantage for AWS (Lambda, ECS, S3, RDS, IAM, etc.). Hands-on experience with microservices, event-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS), and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes). Strong command of software design patterns, SDLC, and system integration strategies. Expertise in design paradigms such as DDD, TDD, EDD, and principles like SOLID, KISS, DRY, SSOT, and CQS. Solid grasp of security fundamentals: encryption, authentication, authorization, data privacy, and secure coding practices. Proficiency with SQL and NoSQL databases, and API design using REST and GraphQL. Practical experience with Git branching strategies, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile development practices. AI-powered engineering (required) Deep, hands-on experience with at least one agentic AI coding tool such as Claude Code , Cursor, GitHub Copilot (Agent Mode), or Codex CLI — used regularly on real, non-trivial work. Practical fluency with AI productivity tools across the broader workflow: LLM chat assistants for design and review, AI-assisted code review, documentation generation, and research. Ability to design effective context for AI agents — writing good prompts, structuring repos and docs (e.g. CLAUDE.md / rules files) so agents perform well, and knowing when to delegate vs. when to drive manually. Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and the broader pattern of connecting AI agents to internal tools, data sources, and services. Awareness of the security, privacy, IP, and quality risks of AI-assisted development, and opinions on how to mitigate them at an organizational level. Experience integrating AI/LLM capabilities and agent-based components into backend products and workflows is a strong plus. Ways of working Demonstrated ability to drive end-to-end delivery of complex features — from architecture through production. Excellent analytical skills and a strong self-learning instinct; comfortable ramping up quickly on unfamiliar domains. Strong communication and influencing skills — able to align engineers, product managers, and senior stakeholders around a technical direction. Excellent written and verbal English. Apply for this position
